item.description:
# WindowHop 1.0.3
- Download, verify, install, and relaunch updates inside WindowHop with Sparkle. - Optional automatic update checks and automatic download/installation in General settings. - App icons in the switcher and a compact vertical Dock preview layout.
This is the first Sparkle-enabled version. Install it manually once; future signed releases can install within the app. Apple Silicon, macOS 13 or later. This free build is not Apple-notarized.
